post.hook: Heat isn't a flavor. It's a decision.
post.copy:
Most sauces hide behind sugar. Ours build a flavor profile — layers that arrive in order, not all at once.

Start sweet. Then the acid cuts in. Then the heat lands last, so you feel it after the bite, not during.

That's the difference between a sauce that shouts and a sauce that stays.

post.hook: Wagyu or it doesn't leave the kitchen.
post.copy:
Wagyu or it doesn't leave the kitchen.

Every build on the menu starts the same way — 100% Wagyu beef. The OG Cheeseburger. The Lobster. The Foie Gras. Same rule, no exceptions.

We don't switch cuts when nobody's looking. The sauce gets the spotlight, but the beef under it earns its place first.

post.hook: Your pour. Your rules. Show us.
post.copy:
Everyone builds it differently. Some flood the box. Some go one clean stripe down the middle. Some dip the first bite, then rethink the whole thing halfway through.

That's the point. The last step is yours.

Glove up. Pick your sauce. Pour it your way. Then film it and tag us — we're running your rituals across our page all month.

Extra sauce is self-respect. We don't make the rules — you do.
